game_concept: A puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Lantern Path, a lantern-lit path: the herbalist must handle mischievous sprites while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Squad Marcher: Loop through a squad list with for ally in squad so each member gets its job.
theme: Mystic Forest – Lantern Path: a lantern-lit path
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Declarations and statements: build a valid C source file that prints 28. Put preprocessing before main; keep declarations and statements inside its body. Then test its compiler-factory route: Build the splitter at (2, 3), with the upper processing path on row 0 and lower path on row 5. Alternate items between A (upper) and B (lower); wait if the scheduled branch is blocked. Assemble components on both paths, then merge them at (8, 3) before the shared output. Deliver exactly 10 components (5 upper, 5 lower). Set the gold-socket controller batch to 10.
controls: Drag sprites onto the grid. R rotates new pieces. Set fork output directions and router conditions in the inspector. Splitters alternate; routers evaluate each item; mergers accept one waiting item at a time fairly. Set batch size, connect power, repair rounded conveyors, then Run or Step. Grid controls are the keyboard alternative.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Squad Marcher' (Week 5 slot 4), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Lantern Path'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: C Components, Keywords, Preprocessor and Organization

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Reach the mushroom ring using at most 17 actions, so every code step counts.
source_win_condition: The mushroom ring reached with actions_used <= 17.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 17 before the mushroom ring is reached, or lives reach 0.
hint: Alternate items between A (upper) and B (lower); wait if the scheduled branch is blocked. Assemble components on both paths, then merge them at (8, 3) before the shared output. Branch contracts: A: 5 components via upper_4, upper_6 to output_shared; B: 5 components via lower_4, lower_6 to output_shared. Power the junctions and production machines. A blocked branch waits without losing items.
